preview.title: As you practice, your progress appears here
preview.text: Below is sample data. Once you practice, your week, the lists to practice next, your weak words, and each list's trend are shown from your own records.

storage: You can use every practice and editing feature without signing in. Word lists, practice history, and devices are saved in this browser. Signing in (with Sparklingstadt ID or GitHub) switches to a separate storage location, your account, which syncs across devices. Data in the browser is not moved automatically.
storageAccount: You are signed in, so your word lists, practice history, and devices are saved to your account and synced with other devices and browsers signed in to the same account. They are kept separately from data saved in this browser without signing in.
